---
title: "Working feedback examples"
---

Enter your own response, then choose **Feedback**. By default, you get a prompt
to paste into an AI chat. Open **Feedback settings** to choose direct API
feedback instead. No API key is included in this document.

## 1. Spanish writing

This course practises simple vocabulary, present-tense verbs and agreement.
The explanation language can differ from the language being practised.

::: {.ai-feedback #spanish-writing profile="language-quality" response-language="es" feedback-language="en" learner-level="Spanish course 1"}
Write five short sentences about your daily routine.

::: {.feedback-criteria}
Focus on present-tense verbs, articles and adjective agreement. Preserve the
learner's simple writing style. Discuss at most three useful improvements.
:::

::: {.feedback-starter}
Yo vive en Trondheim. Cada mañana yo come pan y bebo café.
:::
:::

## 2. Translation

::: {.ai-feedback #translation profile="translation" source-language="en" response-language="es" feedback-language="en" learner-level="Spanish course 1" context="none"}
Translate the following text into Spanish. Preserve its meaning using simple language.

::: {.feedback-source}
Every morning, Maria walks to school with her brother. They like studying languages.
:::

::: {.feedback-starter}
Cada mañana, María camina a la escuela con su hermano. Les gusta estudiar idiomas.
:::
:::

## 3. Shared context and the legacy alias

The old mathematics context class and the shared class identify the same
kind of material. Here the legacy class provides language-course context.

::: {#agreement .math-exercise-context}
An adjective agrees in gender and number with the noun it describes.
:::

::: {.ai-feedback #context-alias profile="language-quality" response-language="es" feedback-language="nb" learner-level="Spanish course 1" context="agreement"}
Write a sentence describing two red houses. Explain improvements in Norwegian Bokmål.

::: {.feedback-starter}
Las casas son rojo.
:::
:::

## 4. Feedback on handwritten Spanish

Upload a photo of a few sentences you wrote in Spanish. A typed response is
optional when the image contains your work. Direct feedback needs a model
that accepts images, such as Kimi K2.6 through NTNU IDUN.

::: {.ai-feedback #handwriting profile="language-quality" response-language="es" feedback-language="en" learner-level="Spanish course 1" image-upload="true" image-role="response" context="none"}
Read the learner's handwritten Spanish. Say when a word is unreadable rather
than guessing. Give up to three improvements to vocabulary, grammar or spelling.
:::

## 5. Describe a picture in Spanish

Upload a picture as the source, then type your description. The picture is
supporting material; your Spanish text is the response being reviewed.

::: {.ai-feedback #describe-picture profile="language-quality" response-language="es" feedback-language="en" learner-level="Spanish course 1" image-upload="true" image-role="source" context="none"}
Describe the uploaded picture in three simple Spanish sentences. Review the
Spanish and whether the description fits the visible picture. Do not invent
details that cannot be seen.
:::

## Adding the next example

Pyodide, mathematics and Python unit-test examples will be added as their
integrations migrate to the shared API. Their existing implementations remain
the reference for compatibility until each migration passes its checks.
